svg.title: Open Source Metro: midnight GitHub-style contribution calendar
svg.desc: SHARED SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Calendar tiles show synthetic source event units, coloured lines show five event kinds, roundels mark repo stations. Blank days do not prove zero actual GitHub contributions.
svg.text: A SQUARE IS A DAY. THE BRIGHTER IT IS, THE MORE OBSERVED UNITS.
